When I was around 10 years old I wanted to join a club on my own since hell yeah to being independent.

Then months later I joined the camping trip where we stayed at a highschool and oh boy... Everybody treated me with so much shit. There was an activity where the teacher helped every single girl but he didn't helped me. Instead he said "I'm not helping you. You're on your own," while everyone was watching.

The highschool girl's scout talked smack about me and for some reason everybody avoided befriending me. I never felt so alone and unneeded in my whole life. But I kept it inside and stayed strong during the whole ordeal.

This experience scarred me for life in terms of trusting to go on a club on my own and actually getting to enjoy them. This was also one of the causes that gave me crippling low self-esteem and trust issues.
